meta.title: ClinicLine: dental clinic software for Hebrew, Arabic and English clinics
meta.description: Appointments, patient files, an interactive tooth chart, treatment plans and payments for dental clinics. Each clinic gets its own private system.

hero.h1: The whole clinic, run from the tooth chart.
hero.sub: ClinicLine is software for dental clinics: appointments, patient files, treatment plans and payments in one place, in Hebrew, Arabic and English.

widget.label: Try the chart
widget.hint: Pick a tooth, then add a finding.
widget.empty: Nothing yet. A finding on a tooth becomes a treatment here.
widget.note: A simplified preview. The real chart has all 32 teeth, with surfaces and notes.

features.title: What it does
features.intro: Everything the front desk, the doctors and the owner touch in a day.

items.d: A day view for each doctor and room. Double bookings are caught before they happen.
Contact details, medical history, allergies, appointments and notes. Find anyone by national ID or name.
Click a tooth to record a finding. The treatment is added to the plan, and completing it updates the chart.
Procedures come from your own price list and move from proposed to completed.
Take cash, card, bank transfer, check or Bit. Keep patient credit and see who owes what.
Keep X-rays and photos with each patient, visible to doctors and admins only.
One account for all your branches. Patients are shared, staff are assigned per branch.
Hebrew, Arabic and English. Hebrew and Arabic are laid out right to left.

roles.title: Each person sees what their job needs

items.d: Their own agenda, patient charts, treatment plans and scans.
The whole day's schedule, check-in and payments. No access to scans.
Staff, branches, the price list, chart settings and who can do what.

security.title: Your patients' data stays yours
security.intro: A patient file is private. This is how ClinicLine treats it.

items.d: Each clinic runs separately with its own database. Nothing is shared with other clinics.
Backups are kept away from the server, and we have tested restoring them.
You can see who opened or changed a patient file, and when.
New passwords must be changed at first sign-in, repeated wrong guesses lock the account, and two-step verification is available.
Ask at any time and we hand over a full export: patient records, tables and scans.

steps.d: How many branches, who works there, and which languages your team uses.
Your price list, your staff accounts and your clinic's name, in a system of its own.
Everyone changes their temporary password at first sign-in, and you are running.

demo.title: See it with sample data first
demo.text: Ask for a demo and we will send you a private link to a sample clinic, filled with made-up patients, that you can click through at your own pace.

items.q: Do I need to install anything?
items.a: No. It runs in a web browser on any computer, tablet or phone.
In your clinic's own database on a server we manage. We agree the hosting region with you.

items.q: Can I take my data with me if I leave?
items.a: Yes. We export patient records, tables and scans whenever you ask.
Yes. Branches share one patient list, and each member of staff is assigned to the branches where they work.
Hebrew, Arabic and English. Each clinic can be set to one language, or let staff pick their own.
It depends on the number of branches and staff. Send us a message and we will quote you.
